note: Copper Glacier's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md; PLAN.md section 5). The ground's KGROUND layers (84-host-ground.js): ground.snow (the firn and snow), ground.algae (the summer firn's snow algae), ground.gravel (the moraine and the outwash), ground.lichen (the crust on the old moraine), rock.granite (the walls: granite, and the stand-in for the gneiss until rock.gneiss.banded is delivered), rock.malachite and rock.gossan (the copper ground, on the resource data's copper), ice.glacier (the ice's surface; tinted verdigris on the copper ground: the stand-in for ice.glacier.verdigris), ice.debris (the dirty snout and the medial moraine). ice.clear is the seracs and bergs (86). The cards: lichen, moss, sedge (card.grass.dry), spike (the copper flower, card.flowerspike). bark.coral is the frost coral's skin (the Throne's gill-coral cap, the cold lineage's own). Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/copperglacier after any change, then python3 build.py.
